title: Deep learning and explainable AI find SARS-CoV-2-specific sequences for primer design
summary: A CNN trained on 553 coronavirus-family sequences and explainable AI uncovered sequences specific to SARS-CoV-2 that separated it from other strains with near-perfect accuracy on other repositories. A primer set from one sequence was synthesised and showed sensitivity similar to routine methods and 100% specificity, tested on six positive patient samples. The patient test is very small. This is a bioRxiv preprint.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network with explainable AI

evidence.tested: Held-out repository validation and wet-lab primer test on six positive patient samples.
evidence.unknown: Preprint; very small patient test (n = 6); full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: CNN classifier analysed with explainable AI to identify virus-specific sequences.
